photos.title: Oceanfront towers along the beach in Myrtle Beach
photos.what: High-rise oceanfront towers with balconies seen from the beach in Myrtle Beach: two tall towers on the left, a coral mid-rise, and a long row of towers along the shore into the distance, with sea oats on the dune and a lifeguard stand at the right.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers along the beach in Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Tall oceanfront towers with rows of balconies behind the dune in Myrtle Beach, with more towers lined up along the beach into the distance under a blue sky
